items.title: nuxt-openapi-hyperfetch
items.description: Own open source project with 2,000+ npm downloads. Automates the data layer in Nuxt apps by generating type-safe composables and server routes from OpenAPI/Swagger contracts.
highlights: One command generates four output types from any OpenAPI spec: useFetch composables, useAsyncData composables, Nuxt Server Routes (to keep API keys server-side), and Connectors.

Connectors are the flagship feature — a single import exposes full CRUD (list, detail, create, update, delete) per resource, with Zod validation, reactive params, pagination and modal state built in. No extra wiring needed.
Global callbacks let you register auth headers, error toasts or logging once for the entire app — intercepted at every API call automatically.
100% Nuxt-native output — no runtime dependencies in the generated code. Works as a CLI (`nxh generate`) or as a Nuxt module with hot-reload on spec changes.

items.title: Cardiosalus App
items.description: Medical app (Web, iOS & Android) built with Ionic + Vue for Cardiosalus — now Ribera Salud. Appointment booking, patient records, document signing and more.
highlights: Built for Cardiosalus (now part of Ribera Salud group) — a fully cross-platform medical app available as a web app, iOS and Android from a single Ionic + Vue codebase.
Appointment booking flow: choose clinic branch, select preferred professional, follow step-by-step scheduling, and cancel or reschedule at any time.
Patient area: access personal medical records, consultation history and clinical documentation directly from the app.
Digital document signing integrated into the patient workflow, removing paper from routine administrative processes.
